title: AI-guided discovery of antifreeze peptides with tandem-repeat architectures
summary: AFPFusionLM, combining protein sequence and structure-aware representations, reached an AUROC of 0.937 and AUPRC of 0.957 on an independent reference set, and with generative sequence expansion and consensus screening of UniProt and glacier metagenomes it found novel repeat-architecture antifreeze peptide families. Several peptides showed ice recrystallization inhibition comparable to or greater than literature references and gave cryoprotection with reduced DMSO. Preprint known from its abstract only, which does not give the number of peptides tested.
ai_technology: AFPFusionLM protein sequence and structure model with generative expansion and consensus screening

evidence.tested: Wet-lab ice recrystallization inhibition assays and cell-based cryoprotection.
evidence.unknown: Number of peptides tested; peer review; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: AFPFusionLM and generative screening nominated the peptides.
